note: Each command is a button. Pressing it sends the request to EVERY controller in the selected group. Objects without a 'label' (like this one) are ignored, so they work as comments. Add/remove commands freely.

'hidden' command: polled in the background for state only, never shown as a button. Here it reads the current screen type; the Вход/Блэкаут/Фриз buttons turn green when the group's current type equals their 'active_value'. VERIFY the read path/field for your firmware (placeholder: getScreenStatus -> obj.type).

A command with 'response_field' is a STATUS button: the (dotted) field is read from each controller's JSON reply, aggregated across the group, and shown on the button (all equal -> value; numbers differ -> min-max range; else a distinct list). An optional 'labels' map turns raw values into names. When the group disagrees, pressing the button opens a per-controller breakdown (last IP octet -> value). Polled in the background and refreshed on press.

Screen test pattern. 'Тест' is the status (testPicEn 0/1). The setters use setTestImage: turn it off, or show a solid white pattern (testPicEn=1 + RGB 1023 = full on 10-bit). areaId/testPicMode/testPicDeep follow the device example — adjust for your hardware.
